name: Laravel Forge
line: Provision and deploy applications to servers you choose.

free.text: Paid subscription; server fees are separate

cells.selfhost: No; Forge's control panel is hosted

work.math: $12 a month Forge fee, plus the server, transfer, storage and domain, priced by your provider. Server size and region are not selected.
$12 a month Forge fee, plus a server running 730 hours with at least 1 core, 1 GHz, 1 GB RAM and 10 GB disk. The provider price varies.
$12 a month Forge fee, plus server, database and network costs that change with use, for 1 GiB and 10 GB. Daily backups are included, but point-in-time recovery (PITR) terms conflict.
